scope: Disposable Edge; prepared AI component explicitly mounted by the test and absent from normal chat; synthetic AI access/responses. No live inference, deposits or user account operations.
checks: unconfigured AI accepts a local draft but cannot send, sign or copy personal chat context
only explicitly typed AI text and minimal signed identity leave the browser; replies render as text and stored account bytes are unchanged
stop aborts the local request, keeps the draft and rejects a late reply without retrying
unverified responses cannot appear in the conversation
AI close clears its session and restores keyboard focus; both themes fit desktop and phone
Receive retains its working destinations and does not offer a catalogue as a receiving address
